sin.name: compaction-request-recorded-outside-the-control
sin.description: Code records a compaction request itself, past the agent control that records the request and then types its line, so a row can exist with no line typed or a line with no row.
sin.rule: Run ChooseAgentControl for the context control, or CompactAgentContext from a suite rule: the control records the request through ContextChangeRequests and types the line.
